description: Ettin (body 2) built from the CC4 male base. Factors are measured from the hand-read idle marks through the character-depth-0447 camera (lateral 31.1 px/m, vertical 31.1 px/m): shoulder joints ~1.7 m apart, thigh ~1.1 m, shin ~0.65 m, forearm ~0.7 m, overall ~2.2x the 1.857 m base. 'length' scales a bone along itself, 'thickness' across it; both are relative to the uniform 'scale'. Iteration 2: lengths corrected by the median mark/model ratios of the first idle fit (torso x1.28, forearm x0.9, hand x0.86, thigh x0.89, shin x0.8, foot x0.75).

second_head.note: The original head moves +offset along +X (anatomical left, head A); a copy of the head region moves -offset (head B), rigid to CC_Base_Head_B and blended into the neck.
